primary_surface: Question intake, AI answer workspace, document evidence, uncertainty flags, approval note.

feature_cards.title: Natural Language Question Answering
feature_cards.description: Ask maintenance and SOP questions in Japanese or simple English and receive evidence-grounded answers.

feature_cards.title: Source Citation & Evidence Panel
feature_cards.description: Every answer includes clickable source citations with highlighted excerpts from manuals, SOPs, and incident reports.

feature_cards.title: Uncertainty & Risk Flagging
feature_cards.description: Automatically detects missing information or safety risks and surfaces warnings before final answer.

feature_cards.title: Supervisor Escalation
feature_cards.description: Safety-critical or ambiguous queries trigger a review workflow, requiring expert approval before release.

feature_cards.title: Human Approval Gate
feature_cards.description: Built-in approval panel for reviewer to accept, edit, or reject AI-drafted answers for regulated actions.

feature_cards.title: Audit Trail
feature_cards.description: Complete log of all queries, evidence, drafts, and approvals for compliance and continuous improvement.

feature_cards.title: Japanese-First Interface
feature_cards.description: Primary UI in Japanese with optional simplified English translations for trainee operators.

ui_primitives.label: Chat Thread
ui_primitives.purpose: Primary conversation interface for operators to ask questions and receive answers with citations.

ui_primitives.label: Evidence Panel
ui_primitives.purpose: Display retrieved documents, manuals, or incident reports with highlighted excerpts.

ui_primitives.label: Risk Checklist
ui_primitives.purpose: Surface safety risks, missing information, and escalation rules.

ui_primitives.label: Approval Panel
ui_primitives.purpose: Show approval status and allow reviewer decision for escalated cases.

ui_primitives.label: Metrics Strip
ui_primitives.purpose: Summarize confidence, evidence count, risk level, and approval status.

custom_product_blueprint.product_name: Nagoya Precision Components Maintenance Knowledge Assistant
custom_product_blueprint.subtitle: AI-powered technical support for factory maintenance and troubleshooting
custom_product_blueprint.product_goal: Troubleshooting equipment alarms and finding maintenance procedures
custom_product_blueprint.ui_composition_strategy: Assemble a responsive product from reusable UI primitives.

layout_strategy.desktop: three-column: sidebar (left) + main chat (center) + context panel (right)
layout_strategy.tablet: two-column: sidebar (collapsible) + main chat; context panel as bottom sheet
layout_strategy.mobile: single-column stacked: chat thread full width, panels as expandable cards below
